source: NHS Organisation Data Service (ODS) ORD API, active NHS trust sites (role RO198) operated by each trust; coordinates from postcodes.io (ONS). Open Government Licence v3.
rule: A hospital is a trust site whose name carries a hospital word and no department word; sites sharing a postcode count once; a hospital named by more than one trust is listed under the trust with the most registered sites at that postcode. Every other site is counted in otherSites.
